title: Comparing and Ordering Numbers
introduction: Learn comparing and ordering numbers through explanations and practice.
definition: Compare whole numbers by checking the tens digit first, then the ones digit. The symbols >, < and = mean greater than, less than and equal to.

examples.question: Compare 47 and 52.
steps: 47 has four tens; 52 has five tens.
Four tens are fewer than five tens.

exercises.question: Write >, < or = : 45 __ 54
exercises.solution: 45 has 4 tens and 54 has 5 tens, so 45 < 54.

exercises.question: Write >, < or = : 80 __ 80
exercises.solution: Both numbers have 8 tens and 0 ones, so 80 = 80.

summary: Compare whole numbers by checking the tens digit first, then the ones digit. The symbols >, < and = mean greater than, less than and equal to.
